name: Wall Washer Lamp
desc: A compact cylindrical wall-mounted washer light with a matte black body and slim vertical brass-tone accents. The fixture creates symmetrical upward and downward light patterns on the wall, making it suitable for architectural accent lighting in modern residential and hospitality interiors.

specifications.Light Distribution: Symmetrical up and down wall wash
specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 220 mm height x 120 mm width
specifications.Recommended Use: Hallway / Living room / Bedroom / Lobby / Accent wall / Hospitality
